overview: The committee reviewed six evolved design alternatives for the new high school and established procedures for evaluating over 200 proposed space reductions. Members approved initial administrative and educational space cuts while tabling more significant changes pending a comprehensive financial analysis of the city's debt capacity and tax impacts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the April 15 building committee meeting.

items.title: SMMA Design Alternatives Update
items.summary: The design team presented six refined options, highlighting site circulation improvements and new phasing strategies that eliminate the need for modular classrooms in most scenarios.

items.title: Resolution: Cost Estimating Guidelines
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution directing cost estimators to provide detailed pricing for parking options, pool features, varying auditorium capacities, and specific community programs.

items.title: Resolution: Space Change Proposal Procedure
items.summary: Approved a procedure to categorize and vote on over 200 space change proposals based on their impact on the established educational plan.

items.title: Resolution: Financial Review Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Voted to dedicate the May 27 meeting to a review of revised cost estimates, city debt capacity, and potential tax impacts before selecting a final design option in June.

items.title: Category A Space Change Proposals
items.summary: Approved dozens of administrative and repurposed space reductions proposed by the educational leadership team while retaining specific performing arts and instructional spaces for further evaluation.

items.title: Category B and C Space Change Proposals
items.summary: Tabled all remaining space change proposals from committee members until after the detailed financial data is presented at the May 27 meeting.

subject: High School Design Alternatives and Space Reductions
